acceptance_criteria: Identical injected append failures produce the documented result for each durability class rather than a component-specific accident.
A successful deadman recovery is delivered once, durably marked resolved, and never replayed solely because its diagnostic append failed.
Collector diagnostic failure cannot silently terminate daemon processing after successful claim, relay, or acknowledgement work.
Dispatcher distinguishes a completed domain transition plus degraded audit sink from a failed dispatch cycle.
Watchdog append failure is visible through an independent bounded health signal without making alert or state reconciliation untruthful.
Q-loop logging failure preserves the original poll or send failure classification instead of replacing it with an unclassified logger exception.
Disk full, read-only filesystem, permission failure, unsafe link, interrupted rotation, short write, fsync failure, and recovery after storage repair are fault-injected.
Crash tests cover every boundary before and after external send, state commit, queue move, remote acknowledgement, and audit append.
Restart reconciliation preserves pending audit obligations without repeating the underlying action.
Health and exit-code tests distinguish domain failure, diagnostic degradation, pending audit, and fully committed outcomes.
Tests and operator receipts contain only bounded classes, counts, and reserved synthetic identifiers.
blast_radius: BOT ERRORS watchdog, q-loop, collector, dispatcher, and deadman diagnostics; collector daemon continuity; dispatcher queue, delivery, incident, and cycle receipts; deadman notification idempotency; controller health and exit-code truth; restart reconciliation; and future shared logging, rotation, and retention behavior.
evidence_summary: Exact pinned blobs preserve five caller-specific failure policies around the same JSONL append boundary: heartbeat watchdog catches and discards every append exception, while q-loop, collector, dispatcher, and deadman writers propagate it. Collector daemon mode has no cycle exception boundary. Dispatcher daemon mode converts an uncaught append exception into a generic failed-cycle state even when a preceding domain transition completed. A write-free canary compiled the exact pinned writer and deadman function bodies with in-memory boundaries: one reserved OSError returned only from watchdog, propagated from the other four writers, and caused two successful synthetic deadman recovery sends across two invocations while producing zero state saves and leaving the durable incident open. Exact changed-file pagination across all 38 open pull requests found no implementation owner; draft PR #2495 collides with three affected paths. A final path-level audit found every recorded decisive, test, and affected path disjoint from the exact 6e1672766027c16ecb06f5e122b491c0e5a0a83f to 45f4889ab5f971d920ca6a05bf857d326c42b81d delta; API and SSH main matched the latter revision, so this record is safely repinned. A final path-level audit found every recorded decisive, test, and affected path disjoint from the exact 45f4889ab5f971d920ca6a05bf857d326c42b81d to c37df83897ce9cd02829289f9f05b01347e4b0de delta; API and SSH main matched the latter revision, so this record is safely repinned. A final path-level audit found every recorded decisive, test, and affected path disjoint from the exact c37df83897ce9cd02829289f9f05b01347e4b0de to f0ece2d18883a66f04892a46669b3547e5bdf2b1 delta; API and SSH main matched the latter revision, so this record is safely repinned.
falsifier_or_remaining_gap: A declared record-class policy plus an independent bounded sink-health channel, durable intent or outbox handling for audit-critical records, and crash tests proving that append failure cannot hide degradation, abort completed work, or replay an external action would falsify the defect. This audit did not run the existing suites because they create temporary directories, and did not inject real disk-full, read-only-filesystem, short-write, interrupted-rotation, or fsync faults; those acceptance cases remain implementation obligations.
impact: The same storage fault can erase watchdog diagnostics without any degradation signal, terminate collector operation, make dispatcher report failure after a completed move or delivery, replace a q-loop domain error with a logger exception, or repeatedly send deadman recovery while durable incident state remains open.
lead_verification_obligations: Re-read live issue identity, labels, body hash, and remote main immediately before registry integration or metadata mutation.
Re-enumerate every open pull request changed-file page immediately before assigning an implementation owner, with explicit attention to preservation PR #2495.
Review the #2508 envelope and #2464 primitive contracts together with this failure policy and preserve #2386 metadata-only serialization boundaries.
Require RED and GREEN matrix, crash-boundary, restart, recovery, sink-health, exit-code, and privacy tests on the exact implementation head.
Keep live log migration, rotation, deletion, deployment, restart, queue mutation, and external notification outside the draft implementation PR.

suggested_remediation: Build the failure contract on the versioned controller-log envelope from #2508 and the shared primitive boundary from #2464. Give each record family an explicit diagnostic-best-effort or audit-critical durability class. Best-effort append failure must preserve truthful domain outcome while updating an independent bounded metadata-only sink-health state; audit-critical intent and transition must use a durable outbox or transaction with restart reconciliation. Persist idempotency state before nonessential logging after external side effects, distinguish domain failure from diagnostic degradation and pending audit in health and exit codes, and apply one explicit daemon exception policy across all five controllers.
title: reliability: controller JSONL failures either disappear silently or abort completed work
